base.text: Reveals when any player ends a turn with unspent mana: Summon an X/X Bread Token for you. X = that player's unspent mana.

radiant.text: Reveals when any player ends a turn with unspent mana: Summon an X/X Bread Token for you. X = 3 × that player's unspent mana.

base.text: Start of turn: Add a random card from your graveyard to your hand.

radiant.text: Start of turn: Discover a card from your graveyard. It costs (1) less.

base.text: Reveals when your opponent plays a Unit: After it resolves, transform it into a Sheep Token.

radiant.text: Reveals when your opponent plays a Unit: After it resolves, transform it into a Sheep Token. Add a Lava Golem to your hand. It costs (0).

radiant.text:

base.text: Reveals when your opponent plays a (1) Cost or less card, if you have an empty unit zone: Summon 2 Rush Tokens. If it's a Unit, they attack it.

radiant.text: Reveals when your opponent plays a card, if you have an empty unit zone: Fill your board with Rush Tokens. If it's a Unit, they attack it.

base.text: Reveals when any turn ends, if your deck has more cards than your opponent's: Recruit a (1) Cost or less Unit.

radiant.text: Reveals when any turn ends, if your deck has more cards than your opponent's: Recruit a (2) Cost or less Unit.

base.text: Discover a card from your graveyard. It costs (1) less. Exile this.

radiant.text: Discover a card from your graveyard. It costs (0). Exile this.

base.text: Your next Spell gains Echo +1. Then this goes to the graveyard.

radiant.text: Your next Spell gains Echo +2. Then this goes to the graveyard.

base.text: Replace every card in your hand, deck, board, graveyard and exile with a random Legendary.

radiant.text: Replace every card in your hand, deck, board, graveyard and exile with a random Radiant Legendary.

base.text: Reveals when your opponent plays a permanent of a type you control: Fuse it onto a random permanent of yours of that type.

radiant.text: Reveals when your opponent plays a permanent of a type you control: Fuse it onto every permanent of yours of that type.

base.text:
Grade (starts at E).
End of turn: If you played N+ cards this turn, go up a grade and trigger every step from E to it. N = the grades from E to the current one.
E: Copy a random card you played this turn into your hand.
D: 2 random cards in hand cost (1) less.
C: Opponent exiles a random hand card.
B: Make a random card in hand Radiant.
A: 8 Lifesteal damage to the enemy hero.
S: Trigger E–A again.

radiant.text:
Grade (starts at E).
Start of turn: Add a Combo-Fodder to your hand.
End of turn: If you played N+ cards this turn, go up a grade and trigger every step from E to it. N = the grades from E to the current one.
E: Copy a random card you played this turn into your hand.
D: 2 random cards in hand cost (1) less.
C: Opponent exiles a random hand card.
B: Make a random card in hand Radiant.
A: 8 Lifesteal damage to the enemy hero.
S: Trigger E–A again.

base.text: Reveals when your opponent declares an attack that would be lethal to your hero: Cancel it. The rest of their turn is played at random.

radiant.text: Reveals when your opponent declares an attack that would be lethal to your hero: Cancel it and destroy the attacker. The rest of their turn is played at random.

radiant.text: Activate ♾️: Tribute another Unit. Deal damage equal to {multiplier}× its Attack.

radiant.text: Cry: Destroy a permanent whose card takes more lines of code to implement than this one.
